whenToUse: A lighter-looking menu icon is needed.
The word Menu can sit beside it.
whenNotToUse: The icon alone must signal a menu (the hamburger is more familiar).
You'd mix it with the hamburger in the same service.
The animation turning it into close (×) looks awkward.

alternatives.name: Hamburger ☰
alternatives.reason: A menu made of three horizontal lines.

alternatives.name: Stairs
alternatives.reason: An icon of staggered horizontal lines.

accessibility: The word Menu beside the icon becomes the button's name.
The open menu closes with a close button and Esc.
Mark the current page with aria-current.
